title: 第15章 被下药了第16章 果然是你下的药
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 听莫阳这么说，苏菲儿也没有停留。
“莫阳哥哥，那你安心修炼，明天我再来看你！”
苏菲儿说完之后，笑嘻嘻的转身离开了小院。
莫阳不停地擦着额头的冷汗，一脸惊诧的看着明明已经走出去，却又凑回来扶在院门口朝他挥手的苏菲儿，感觉整个人都不对劲了。
“莫阳哥哥，那我走了哦！”
莫阳急忙点头，直至小院中彻底安静下来，他才长长松了一口气。
他欲哭无泪，若是苏菲儿像以往一样，他还好对付一些，如今他是完全没有办法。
这种反常的举动，直接给莫阳整不会了。
他赶紧进入屋中，反手将房门关上，随后躲进了石塔中炼丹去了。
只是莫阳没想到，因为他给苏菲儿的洗髓丹，才当天晚间，灵虚宗就彻底闹翻了天……
离开木峰后，苏菲儿便回到了主峰上，随后迫不及待的将那一瓶驻颜丹一股脑吞了下去。
不仅如此，随后她又将洗髓丹整整一瓶也吃了个干净。
在木峰上莫阳说洗髓丹功效的时候，苏菲儿根本就没有去听，她还以为和驻颜丹一样也是养颜美容的。
将两瓶丹药服下后，才几息的时间，她便感觉整个人都不对劲了。
意识渐渐昏沉，体内像是有无尽的烈火在燃烧一样，那足足三十枚丹药化成两股狂暴的力量在她周身肆虐。
别说是三十枚，寻常修者就算是同时服用两枚也很难忍受，更何况这两种丹药的功效完全不一样。
还好恰逢徐欣去找她，只是看到苏菲儿的时候，徐欣也被吓得不轻。
苏菲儿脸颊红得像是熟透的苹果，额头上暴起了一道道青筋，豆大的汗珠不停的从她额头上滚落下来，周身衣裙以肉眼可见的速度被浸湿，意识似乎也模糊了。
看到苏菲儿这副模样，徐欣手足无措，只能第一时间带着苏菲儿去找灵虚宗的长老。
一时间，宗门大殿中的长老都被惊动了。
太上长老和宗主第一时间冲上前来查看，只是苏菲儿的情况太过吓人，让不少长老都纷纷皱眉，有些手足无措。
“太上长老，这到底是什么情况？”连宗主也完全看不明白，关键是看着苏菲儿那满脸的痛苦之色，让他心急如焚。
太上长老第一反应便是认为苏菲儿恐怕误食了什么，因为那根本不是修炼中会出现的症状。
“她体内有两股庞大的力量在疯狂肆虐，真气彻底失控了，若是压制不住，恐怕……”
太上长老一番感应之后，神色也彻底凝重起来，他急忙出手，将体内力量灌入苏菲儿体内。
然而结果让他神色大变，那两股力量压根不受控制，散布在苏菲儿四肢百骸中，竟然压制不了。
“到底发生了什么？”
太上长老抬头看向徐欣，毕竟是徐欣送来的。
而且出现这种情况必有缘由，不可能平白无故。
“这……我也不知道……”徐欣也彻底慌了神，苏菲儿和她去往木峰的时候一切尚且还好好的，怎么会……
不过她想起来她和苏菲儿离开木峰之后，苏菲儿途中溜走了，说有什么事情，她记得苏菲儿离去的方向好像是木峰的方向。
“小师妹好像去过木峰……只是……”她也不敢确定，毕竟这种事情她也不敢无凭无据就诬陷莫阳。
“木峰？莫阳……他莫非给菲儿下了药！”
大长老一脸怒意，提到木峰，任谁都只会联想到莫阳，毕竟木峰上只有莫阳一人。
content_en:
After hearing what Mo Yang said, Sophie didn't stop.
"Brother Mo Yang, then you can practice with peace of mind. I will come see you tomorrow!"
After Sophie finished speaking, she turned around and left the courtyard with a smile.
Mo Yang kept wiping the cold sweat from his forehead, looking at Su Feier with surprise as he had already walked out, but then came back to support him at the door of the hospital and waved to him. He felt that something was wrong with his whole body.
"Brother Mo Yang, I'm leaving then!"
Mo Yang nodded hurriedly, and he breathed a long sigh of relief until the small courtyard became completely quiet.
He wanted to cry but had no tears. If Sophie was like before, he would be able to deal with it better, but now he has absolutely no choice.
This kind of abnormal behavior would be impossible for Mo Yang to deal with immediately.
He quickly entered the house, closed the door with his backhand, and then hid in the stone tower to refine elixirs.
It's just that Mo Yang didn't expect that because of the marrow-cleansing pill he gave Sophie, the Lingxu Sect would be completely in trouble just that night...
…
After leaving Mufeng, Sophie returned to the main peak, and then couldn't wait to swallow the bottle of Zhuyan Pill.
Not only that, she then drank the entire bottle of Marrow Cleansing Pill.
When Mo Yang talked about the effects of the Marrow Cleansing Pill on Mufeng, Sophie didn't listen at all. She thought that like the Beauty Pill, it was also for beauty.
After taking two bottles of elixir, she felt that something was wrong with her whole body after just a few breaths.
Her consciousness gradually faded, and it was like there was endless fire burning in her body. The thirty pills turned into two violent forces that raged around her.
Not to mention thirty pills, it would be difficult for ordinary cultivators to endure even taking two pills at the same time, not to mention that the effects of these two pills are completely different.
Fortunately, it happened that Xu Xin went to find her, but when she saw Sophie, Xu Xin was also frightened.
Sophie's cheeks were as red as a ripe apple, and veins popped up on her forehead. Big beads of sweat kept rolling down her forehead. Her clothes were soaked at a speed visible to the naked eye, and her consciousness seemed to be blurred.
Seeing Sophie's appearance, Xu Xin was at a loss and could only take Sophie to find the elders of Lingxu Sect immediately.
For a moment, the elders in the sect hall were alarmed.
The Supreme Elder and the Sect Master immediately rushed forward to check, but Sophie's condition was so scary that many elders frowned and felt a little at a loss.
"Supreme Elder, what is going on here?" Even the sect leader couldn't understand it at all. The key was that seeing Sophie's face full of pain made him anxious.
The Supreme Elder's first reaction was to think that Sophie might have eaten something by mistake, because that was not a symptom that would appear during cultivation at all.
"There are two huge forces raging crazily in her body, and her true energy is completely out of control. If she cannot suppress it, I'm afraid..."
After sensing the situation, the Supreme Elder's expression became completely solemn. He hurriedly took action and poured his power into Sophie's body.
However, the result made his expression change drastically. The two forces were completely out of control. They were scattered among Sophie's limbs and could not be suppressed.
"What happened?"
The Supreme Elder looked up at Xu Xin. After all, it was Xu Xin who sent it.
And there must be a reason for this to happen, it cannot be just for no reason.
"This... I don't know..." Xu Xin was also completely panicked. When Sophie and she went to Mu Feng, everything was still fine. How could...
However, she remembered that after she and Sophie left Mufeng, Sophie slipped away on the way and said something happened. She remembered that the direction Sophie left seemed to be the direction of Mufeng.
"Junior sister seems to have been to Mufeng... It's just..." She wasn't sure, after all, she didn't dare to frame Mo Yang for this kind of thing without any evidence.
"Mu Feng? Mo Yang...could he have drugged Fei'er!"
The Great Elder had an angry look on his face. When he mentioned Mu Feng, everyone would only think of Mo Yang. After all, there was only Mo Yang on Mu Feng.
